node.label: Elevated circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
node.definition: An increased level of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood. 17-hydroxyprogesterone is an intermediate steroid in the adrenal biosynthetic pathway from cholesterol to cortisol and is the substrate for steroid 21-hydroxylase.

diseases.label: classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency
